name: @melloware/jquery.browser
author: Melloware <mellowaredev@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:umd && npm run build:minify
scripts.build:umd:
esbuild src/jquery.browser.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=jQBrowser --outfile=dist/jquery.browser.js --banner:js="/*!

 * https://github.com/gabceb/jquery-browser-plugin

 * http://jquery.org/license
 *
 * Modifications Copyright 2015 Gabriel Cebrian, 2025 Melloware
 * https://github.com/gabceb
 *
 * Released under the MIT license
 */"
scripts.build:minify:
esbuild dist/jquery.browser.js --minify --outfile=dist/jquery.browser.min.js --banner:js="/*!
 * jQuery Browser Plugin 1.0.0
 * https://github.com/gabceb/jquery-browser-plugin
 *
 * Original jquery-browser code Copyright 2005, 2015 jQuery Foundation, Inc. and other contributors
 * http://jquery.org/license
 *
 * Modifications Copyright 2015 Gabriel Cebrian, 2025 Melloware
 * https://github.com/gabceb
 *
 * Released under the MIT license
 */"

description: A jQuery plugin for browser detection.
